name: RGB Glitch Slices
desc: Datamoshed horizontal slice tears that displace the frame in bursts on bass and section changes, with chromatic RGB fringe, rolling scan bands and data-error blocks flickering over a calm baseline.

amount.doc: overall glitch intensity (slice count + tear amplitude)

hue.doc: tint hue for bands/blocks (mono style base)

style.doc: datamosh=horizontal slice tears + rgb fringe / chromatic=soft lens aberration, no tears / sort=vertical streak smears (pixel-sort abstraction) / databend=rectangular block displacement + solid error blocks / mono=single-hue duotone chiaroscuro, no color split

act.doc: calm_bursts=mostly clean, rare big tears / building=glitch density ramps with the musical arc / storm=constant heavy corruption
